{{Short description|Danish botanist (born 1959)}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=June 2026}}
'''Finn Borchsenius''' (born 1959) is a Danish botanist, with interest in [[Spermatophyte|spermatophytes]].<ref name="IPNI">{{cite web |title=Borchsenius, Finn (1959-) |url=https://www.ipni.org/a/14615-1 |website=International Plant Names Index |access-date=2 June 2026}}</ref> He is an expert of the [[Arecaceae]], or palm family.<ref name="fp7">{{cite web |title=Finn Borchsenius |url=https://www.fp7-palms.org/index.php/participants/aarhus-university/finn-borchsenius.html |website=Palm Harvest Impacts in Tropical Forests |access-date=2 June 2026}}</ref>

Borchsenius earned a [[PhD]] from [[Aarhus University]] in 1992.<ref name="BEISA">{{cite web |title=Curriculum Vitae Finn Borchsenius Kristensen |url=https://beisa.dk/Participants/Finn%20Borchsenius/FinnBorchseniusCV.html |website=Biodiversity and Economically Important Species in the Tropical Andes |access-date=2 June 2026}}</ref> In 1991, he became assistant professor in the Department of Systematic Botany at Aarhus University, and since 1997 he has been associate professor there.<ref name="manual">{{cite book |last1=Borchsenius |first1=Finn |last2=Borgtoft Pedersen |first2=Henrik |last3=Balslev |first3=Henrik |title=Manual to the palms of Ecuador |date=1998 |publisher=Aarhus University |isbn=8787600536}}</ref><ref name="Aarhus">{{cite web |title=Finn Borchsenius |url=https://www.au.dk/en/finn.borchsenius@sm.au.dk |website=Aarhus University |access-date=2 June 2026}}</ref> He also manages the herbarium at Aarhus University. Borchsenius previously worked as vice-dean for education at the Faculty of Technical Sciences and the Faculty of Science and Technology at Aarhus University.<ref name="Knudsen">{{cite news |last1=Knudsen |first1=Jeppe Kyhne |title=Finn Borchsenius resigns as vice-dean at Aarhus University |url=https://tech.au.dk/en/about-the-faculty/news/show/artikel/finn-borchsenius-resigns-as-vice-dean-at-aarhus-university |access-date=2 June 2026 |date=7 February 2025}}</ref> From 1992 to 1994, he served as Director of the Herbarium at the [[Pontifical Catholic University of Ecuador]].
